question: As per National Horticulture Database published by National Horticulture Board, during 2015-16, India held the first position in the world for producing which of the following fruits?
solution:
The answer is __**Mangoes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

__
 
• **India is the world's leading mango-producing country.**
 
• The production here reaches over 18 million tonnes, which is approximately 50% of the global mango supply.
 
• **Areas of Cultivation:**
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Bihar, Gujarat and Tamil Nadu**
 
• **Uttar Pradesh ranks first in mango production with a share of 23.47 % and the highest productivity.**
